The collector retries a failed request t.text:
The sentence is wrong. The default fetcher retries once, not three times.

`WebFetcher` defaults to `retries=1`, so it makes two attempts in all. The two places that construct it elsewhere don't change that. `pdf_links.py` passes `retries=0`, and the other call sites use the default. It also gives up at once on 404/410 and on refused or unresolvable hosts. The loop is in `WebFetcher._fetch`.

The input sits above the note in the box and `.rd-boxes` uses `align-items: start`, so the other boxes don't shift either. Boxes with no previous value have no note at all, and nothing toggles for them, so there is no jump there either.
